title: Clinic Missing Patient Calls? A Callback Ownership Path
buyer_phrases: missed call callback system for clinic
answer: Reconcile the call window, separate call types, name a queue owner, set callback statuses, verify a safe handoff, and only then compare staffing, routing, CRM or AI receptionist options.
